subject: Contract edit sprint + final demo — scheduling and roles
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Cheng <alice@catalyst-io.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@catalyst-io.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract edit sprint + final demo — scheduling and roles

Hi Alice / Daniel —

Thanks again for the productive call today. As discussed, Catalyst is ready to run a short contract-editing sprint with legal/procurement and a follow-on technical deep-dive demo for your engineers. To keep this efficient, we propose splitting into two contiguous slots on the same day:

- 60 minutes: contract review + redlines (legal + procurement + AE + our legal lead)
- 45 minutes: technical demo + security Q&A (SE + your engineers + our infra/security lead)

I attached the current redlines (Catalyst_Redlines_v3.pdf) and a draft agenda (proposed-demo-agenda.xlsx). Please confirm:
1) Who from your side will own the contract note-taking / redline reconciliation?
2) Which timezone and 3 potential windows next week work best?
3) Any non-disclosure or evidence bundle we should prep ahead of the demo (SOC2 report, network diagram, etc.)?

Internal: Aisha and Mateo — I’ll need you both to cover AE + SE for these sessions. Rachel, can you own procurement coordination if Tom from Procurement joins? Lauren, can you standby to lead redline discussion? Vivek, FYI — may need a 15m leadership pre-brief depending on the ask.

Goal: lock a single calendar block that lets legal finish the redlines and the technical team validate the integration story same-day.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
From: Alice Cheng <alice@catalyst-io.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <dpark@catalyst-io.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@procurex.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract edit sprint + final demo — scheduling and roles

Thanks Soojin — this sounds good.

Quick answers:
- I will own the redline consolidation from Catalyst's side and circulate a clean copy after the meeting.
- Attendees we plan to have: me, Daniel (security lead), Tom (procurement), and Priya (integration engineer) — I'll add Priya once I confirm.
- Evidence bundle: we can provide our SOC2 summary and a network diagram; I'll upload them to the Drive link you shared before the meeting.

Our availability next week (PDT):
- Tue 7/14: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 7/15: 11:00–13:00

If it helps, we prefer Tue 7/14 10:30–12:15 (fits our procurement windows). Let me know if that aligns with your team.

—Alice
Director, Alliances
Catalyst.io
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Cheng <alice@catalyst-io.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract edit sprint + final demo — scheduling and roles

Alice — Tue 7/14 is workable for us. We can do 10:30–12:15 PDT (1h15m block). Proposed breakdown: 10:30–11:30 contract redlines; 11:30–12:15 technical demo + Q&A. Mateo will run the demo portion and I’ll handle the commercial/contract points.

Lauren — can you lead redlines and flag anything that requires leadership escalation?
Rachel — can you coordinate pricing/credits and any procurement paperwork with Tom?

If no blockers, I'll send a formal invite with the two agenda attachments and a short pre-brief doc.

Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks — I’ll lead the redline session. Two quick asks before the meeting:
1) Please confirm which contract version Alice wants as the baseline (I see v3 attached; if you prefer v2->v3 change-log, send it).
2) If Catalyst has any non-standard clauses they consider mandatory (data residency, deletion windows, etc.), mark them in the PDF and send ahead so my team can triage.

I’ll prepare a one-page deck summarizing the changes we expect to propose so the meeting stays focused.

Lauren
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Soojin — loop me into the calendar invite and flag any items that would require approval beyond standard discounts.

Perfect — locking Tue 2026-07-14 10:30–12:15 PDT.

Calendar invite sent (please accept). Agenda attached and Drive folder shared with Catalyst (contains SOC2 summary + network diagram once Alice uploads).

Plan for the day:
- 10:30–11:30: Contract redline session (Lauren lead, Aisha note-take with Alice consolidating)
- 11:30–12:15: Technical demo + security Q&A (Mateo lead, Daniel from Catalyst on security)
- Optional: 12:15–12:30: Leadership wrap (Vivek optionally joins)

Action items before the meeting:
- Alice: upload SOC2 + diagram to shared Drive
- Catalyst: flag any mandatory clauses in the PDF (Alice)
- Lauren: prepare one-pager on proposed legal positions
- Rachel: prepare procurement checklist and payment timeline to share with Tom

Attachments referenced: Catalyst_Redlines_v3.pdf, proposed-demo-agenda.xlsx

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this out.
